name: mewa-ui
description: Vanilla, accessible, monochrome component library for personal services.

scripts.penpot:extract: node penpot/extract-contracts.mjs && node penpot/extract-foundations.mjs && node penpot/compile-plan.mjs
scripts.penpot:check: node penpot/extract-contracts.mjs && node penpot/extract-foundations.mjs && node penpot/compile-plan.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- penpot/source-contracts.generated.json penpot/foundations.generated.json penpot/sync-manifest.generated.json
scripts.test: node tests/catalog-contract.test.js && npm run test:penpot && node tests/runtime-contract.test.js
